Stages: no food slips; slips at the default chance and every fall the next move can take; then the card's own world, which adds `back_fall_chance: 0.25`: a quarter of the slips drop the food behind the agent and turn it a quarter aside, so the next move cannot take it and one more turn is needed (box-carry's `fall_turn: side` back case). The third stage starts when the last 100 episodes serve 10 orders on average and catch 90% of the falls on the next move. In the final world the scripted solving worker catches 77.6% of the falls on its very next move (2352 falls, 300 episodes) and is judged success on 19 of 100 episodes, so the solving plan breaks the food clause on some seeds (event seed 2, step 16) and the gate's plan check fails: that is the test, a rule the world sometimes makes impossible, not a machine fault.
